  <style>
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Regular.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Medium.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Bold.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 700; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Heavy.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 900; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    :root {
      /* === light-mode lab palette === */
      --paper:        #f5f1e6;   /* warm cream background */
      --paper-deep:   #ede6d3;   /* slightly deeper for elevation */
      --card:         #fdfbf5;   /* slightly off-white card surface */
      --ink:          #15110a;   /* deep warm black */
      --ink-soft:     #2c271d;   /* dim ink */
      --ink-mute:     #6a6356;   /* mute */
      --ink-faint:    #98917f;   /* faint */
      --rule:         #d8d0bb;   /* hairline borders */
      --rule-strong:  #b8ae93;   /* stronger borders */
      --accent:       #8a6a2a;   /* deep ochre */
      --accent-warm:  #a08438;   /* warmer ochre for hover */
      --accent-faint: rgba(138,106,42,0.10);
      --accent-line:  rgba(138,106,42,0.30);
      --accent-text:  #7f5f26;   /* ochre for TEXT on creme. 5.22:1 on --paper, 5.69:1 on --card (AA) */
      --accent-deep:  #6a4f1f;   /* hover fill for solid ochre CTAs. --card text on it: 7.38:1 */
      --jade-deep:    #235953;   /* hover fill for solid teal CTAs. --card text on it: 7.73:1 */
      --jade:         #2d6e6a;   /* secondary muted teal */
      --jade-faint:   rgba(45,110,106,0.08);
      --pulse:        #1d8a82;   /* live indicator */

      --font-display: 'Sweet Sans Pro', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --font-mono:    'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
      --ease:         cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1);

      --grid-max:     1180px;
      --gutter:       clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 4rem);

      /* === SPACING SCALE (4/8 grid). Use these, not ad-hoc rems === */
      --space-1: 0.25rem;   /* 4 */
      --space-2: 0.5rem;    /* 8 */
      --space-3: 0.75rem;   /* 12 */
      --space-4: 1rem;      /* 16 */
      --space-5: 1.5rem;    /* 24 */
      --space-6: 2rem;      /* 32 */
      --space-7: 3rem;      /* 48 */
      --space-8: 4rem;      /* 64 */
      --space-9: 6rem;      /* 96 */

      /* === TYPE SCALE (major-third, 1.25 ratio) === */
      --fs-display-1: clamp(2.25rem, 5.2vw, 4.25rem);  /* hero h1 */
      --fs-display-2: clamp(1.65rem, 3.6vw, 2.6rem);   /* h2 */
      --fs-display-3: clamp(1.2rem, 1.9vw, 1.5rem);    /* h3 */
      --fs-lead:      clamp(1rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem);      /* hero-sub, lead, blurb, lab-body */
      --fs-body:      0.9375rem;                        /* 15px body */
      --fs-mono-xs:   0.625rem;   /* 10px. Eyebrow, table th, badge */
      --fs-mono-sm:   0.75rem;    /* 12px. Captions, status pills, footer links */
      --fs-mono-md:   0.8125rem;  /* 13px. Leaderboard td, arch-foot */
      --fs-mono-lg:   0.875rem;   /* 14px. Body alt, code blocks */

      /* === RADIUS SYSTEM === */
      --radius-pill:  999px;
      --radius-card:  8px;
      --radius-chip:  3px;
      --radius-sm:    4px;

      /* === SHADOW SYSTEM === */
      --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 24px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.06);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 48px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.08), 0 2px 8px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.04);

      /* === NAV-INVERSE TOKENS ===
         The header always CONTRASTS the body. Light body -> dark header (below).
         Overridden under html.dark to flip to a light (creme) header. */
      --nav-bg:        #16120b;
      --nav-surface:   #221b10;
      --nav-ink:       #f4efe2;
      --nav-ink-mute:  #b3a98d;
      --nav-rule:      rgba(244,239,226,0.12);
      --nav-accent:    #cda85f;
      --nav-cta-bg:    #a88c46;
      --nav-cta-ink:   #16120b;
      --nav-cta-hover: #c6a458;
    }

    /* === DARK MODE — warm on-brand palette (rule 46). Body tokens FLIP; nav tokens flip OPPOSITE (creme header). === */
    html.dark {
      --paper:        #100d07;
      --paper-deep:   #1a150c;
      --card:         #201a10;
      --ink:          #f2ede0;
      --ink-soft:     #d5cdba;
      --ink-mute:     #9a927e;
      --ink-faint:    #6e6656;
      --rule:         #2c2618;
      --rule-strong:  #403827;
      --accent:       #b08f45;
      --accent-warm:  #c6a458;
      --accent-faint: rgba(176,143,69,0.14);
      --accent-line:  rgba(176,143,69,0.30);
      /* products-e-only text/hover tokens: flip to the warm-dark set so ochre text + solid CTAs stay legible on the dark grounds */
      --accent-text:  #c6a458;
      --accent-deep:  #c6a458;
      --jade-deep:    #2f8f85;
      /* the security accent lives on --cyan here; map the warm-dark cyan onto the existing security tokens + --pulse */
      --cyan:         #36d8ca;
      --cyan-faint:   rgba(54,216,202,0.12);
      --cyan-line:    rgba(54,216,202,0.30);
      --jade:         #36d8ca;
      --jade-faint:   rgba(54,216,202,0.12);
      --pulse:        #36d8ca;
      --shadow-sm:    0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      --shadow-md:    0 6px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      --shadow-lg:    0 16px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);

      /* nav flips to LIGHT (creme) header when the body is dark */
      --nav-bg:        #f5f1e6;
      --nav-surface:   #ede6d3;
      --nav-ink:       #16120b;
      --nav-ink-mute:  #6a6356;
      --nav-rule:      rgba(21,17,10,0.12);
      --nav-accent:    #6f5316; /* deep ochre: passes AA (5.9:1) as text on the creme header + makes the brain the strongest right-side glyph */
      --nav-cta-bg:    #16120b;
      --nav-cta-ink:   #f5f1e6;
      --nav-cta-hover: #2c271d;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; overflow-x: hidden; }
    body {
      background: var(--paper);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-feature-settings: 'ss01' on, 'ss02' on, 'cv01' on, 'liga' on;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }
    /* paper texture: very subtle warm noise via radial gradients */
    body::before {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 8% 0%, rgba(138,106,42,0.04) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 100% 100%, rgba(45,110,106,0.03) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 50%, transparent 60%, rgba(138,106,42,0.025) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease); }
    a:hover { color: var(--accent-warm); }
    a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .nav-hamburger:focus-visible, .nav-drawer-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    ::selection { background: var(--accent); color: var(--paper); }
    code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.85em;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
    }

    /* === LAYOUT GRID === */
    .container {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 var(--gutter);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .section {
      padding: clamp(4rem, 10vh, 9rem) 0;
      position: relative;
    }
    .rule {
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rule-strong) 0%, var(--rule) 50%, transparent 100%);
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* === TYPOGRAPHY === */
    h1, h2, h3, h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-feature-settings: 'ss01' on, 'salt' on;
    }
    h2 {
      font-weight: 500;      font-size: var(--fs-display-2);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      line-height: 1.18;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
      max-width: 32ch;
    }
    h3 {
      font-weight: 500;      font-size: var(--fs-display-3);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    p {
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      max-width: 60ch;
    }
    p.lead {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 400;      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 50ch;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
    }
    p + p { margin-top: var(--space-3); }

    /* === SECTION LABEL (eyebrow) === */
    .eyebrow {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.32em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent-text);
      margin-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 3vh, 2.5rem);
    }
    /* Austere lab-document numerals: same mono treatment as the label */
    .eyebrow .num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      color: var(--accent-text);
      letter-spacing: 0.32em;
    }
    .eyebrow .line {
      flex-grow: 0;
      width: 2.5rem;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--accent-line);
      transform-origin: left;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transition: transform 0.9s var(--ease) 0.3s;
    }
    .visible .eyebrow .line,
    .eyebrow.visible .line { transform: scaleX(1); }
    .eyebrow .num { white-space: nowrap; }
    .eyebrow .num,
    .eyebrow .label { transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease) 0.15s; }

    /* === NAV === */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      padding: var(--space-4) max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-left)) var(--space-4) max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-right));
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      transition: background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease, border-color .25s ease;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px), (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .nav {
        backdrop-filter: none;
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
        background: var(--nav-bg);
      }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .nav, .nav-drawer, .nav-cta-agent, .nav-social-icon, .nav-icon-link,
      .nav-theme-toggle, .nav-hamburger, .nav-drawer-close, .nav-drawer-links a,
      .nav-drawer-socials a, .drawer-theme-toggle {
        transition: none !important;
      }
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }
    .wordmark {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;      font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: color .25s ease;
    }
    .wordmark .brand-name { color: var(--nav-ink); }
    .wordmark .brand-mark {
      width: 0;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: width 0.3s var(--ease);
    }
    .wordmark .brand-mark.has-logo {
      width: 32px;
      background-image: url("/sibyl-labs-logo-light.png"); /* creme mark on the dark header (light mode) */
      background-size: contain;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-position: center;
    }
    html.dark .wordmark .brand-mark.has-logo {
      background-image: url("/sibyl-labs-logo.png"); /* dark mark on the creme header (dark mode) */
    }
    .wordmark .brand-name { display: inline-block; }

    /* --- Center: social icons --- */
    .nav-socials {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }
    .nav-social-icon {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-social-icon:hover {
      color: var(--nav-accent);
      background: var(--nav-rule);
    }
    .nav-social-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* --- Right: page links + Meet the Agent CTA --- */
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      align-items: center;
    }
    .nav-icon-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease);
      position: relative;
      background: transparent;
    }
    .nav-icon-link:hover {
      color: var(--nav-accent);
      border-color: var(--nav-accent);
      background: var(--nav-rule);
    }
    .nav-icon-link svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    /* connectome button — no ring, larger, brand gold so it stands out */
    .nav-brain { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: none; color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-brain svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; stroke-width: 1.9; }
    .nav-brain:hover { background: none; color: var(--nav-ink); transform: scale(1.08); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .nav-brain:hover { transform: none; } }

    /* Tooltip */
    .nav-icon-link::after {
      content: attr(data-tooltip);
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-bg);
      background: var(--nav-ink);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.15s var(--ease), transform 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-icon-link:hover::after {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    }

    /* --- Theme toggle (lightbulb). Shares the .nav-icon-link geometry/hit-area --- */
    .nav-theme-toggle {
      cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent;
      font: inherit;
    }
    .nav-theme-toggle svg {
      transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    /* Icon states: rays shown in LIGHT mode (bulb "on"), hidden in DARK mode */
    .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 1; transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease); }
    html.dark .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 0; }
    /* filament brightens in light, dims to outline in dark */
    .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-fill { opacity: 0.9; transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease); }
    html.dark .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-fill { opacity: 0.35; }
    @media (pointer: coarse) {
      .nav-theme-toggle { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
    }

    /* Meet the Agent CTA. Gradient flare */
    .nav-cta-agent {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5);
      min-height: 36px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-cta-ink);
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: var(--nav-cta-bg);
      transition: transform 0.22s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.22s var(--ease), background-color 0.22s ease, color 0.22s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    /* keyframes retained — still used by body .btn-primary (unchanged) */
    @keyframes cta-shimmer {
      0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
      50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    }
    .nav-cta-agent:hover {
      color: var(--nav-cta-ink);
      background: var(--nav-cta-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    }
    @media (pointer: coarse) {
      .nav-cta-agent { min-height: 44px; }
    }

    /* --- Mobile: hide desktop links, show hamburger --- */
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .nav-socials { display: none; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .nav-hamburger { display: flex; }
    }
    @media (min-width: 721px) {
      .nav-hamburger { display: none; }
      /* true-center the social icons at the middle of the header: 1fr | auto | 1fr
         puts the socials in a centered track flanked by equal-width side tracks */
      .nav-inner {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
        align-items: center;
      }
      .nav-inner > .wordmark   { justify-self: start; }
      .nav-inner > .nav-socials { justify-self: center; }
      .nav-inner > .nav-links  { justify-self: end; }
    }

    /* --- Mobile hamburger button --- */
    .nav-hamburger {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: var(--nav-surface);
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      cursor: pointer;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
      transition: color 0.22s var(--ease), border-color 0.22s var(--ease), background-color 0.22s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .nav-hamburger:hover,
    .nav-hamburger:focus-visible {
      border-color: var(--nav-accent);
      color: var(--nav-accent);
      outline: none;
    }
    .nav-hamburger svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }

    /* --- Mobile drawer --- */
    .nav-drawer-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(21, 17, 10, 0.4);
      z-index: 199;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.25s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
    .nav-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      width: min(320px, 85vw);
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      z-index: 200;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease), background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    }
    .nav-drawer.open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    .nav-drawer-close {
      align-self: flex-end;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-close:hover { border-color: var(--nav-accent); color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-drawer-close svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .nav-drawer-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .nav-drawer-links a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      min-height: 48px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      transition: background 0.15s var(--ease), color 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-links a:hover {
      background: var(--nav-rule);
      color: var(--nav-accent);
    }
    .nav-drawer-links .drawer-cta { color: var(--nav-accent); font-weight: 600; }
    .nav-drawer-links .drawer-sep {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--nav-rule);
      margin: var(--space-3) 0;
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: auto;
      padding-top: var(--space-6);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials a {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials a:hover { color: var(--nav-accent); border-color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-drawer-socials svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* --- Drawer theme toggle row (matches drawer link geometry) --- */
    .drawer-theme-toggle {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      width: 100%;
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      min-height: 48px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s var(--ease), color 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .drawer-theme-toggle:hover {
      background: var(--nav-rule);
      color: var(--nav-accent);
    }
    .drawer-theme-toggle svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 1; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 0; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .label-dark { display: inline; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .label-light { display: none; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .label-dark { display: none; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .label-light { display: inline; }

    /* Anchor jumps must clear the fixed nav. */
    section[id] {
      scroll-margin-top: 5rem;
    }

    @keyframes fade-up   { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } }

    /* Status pill colorways. USED (with .status-dev) by .uc-status pills inside .product-head/.price-head; base pill geometry lives in the TWO-PRODUCT block below. */
    .status-live  { background: var(--jade-faint);   color: var(--jade);   border: 1px solid rgba(45,110,106,0.25); }
    .status-soon  { background: transparent;          color: var(--ink-mute); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); }

    /* Global em normalisation for the same reason. Emphasis carried by
       accent color + weight, never browser-synthesised italic. */
    em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* === CONTACT === */
    .contact-block {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      padding: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) { .contact-block { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } }
    .contact-block h2 { margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
    .contact-block .contact-sub {
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.3vw, 1.1rem);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 48ch;
    }
    .contact-cta-stack {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .contact-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      min-height: 48px;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--ink);
      transition: all 0.2s var(--ease);
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) {
      .contact-link { width: auto; min-width: 280px; }
    }
    .contact-link:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      color: var(--accent-text);
    }
    .contact-link .icon {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      stroke: currentColor;
      stroke-width: 1.5;
      fill: none;
    }
    .contact-link .label {
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      margin-right: 0.35rem;
    }
    .contact-link .value {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    /* === FOOTER === */
    .footer {
      padding:
        clamp(3rem, 7vh, 5rem)
        max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-right))
        max(clamp(2rem, 5vh, 3rem), env(safe-area-inset-bottom))
        max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-left));
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem);
      align-items: start;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr; } }

    /* brand block */
    .footer-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3); max-width: 34rem; }
    .footer-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; text-decoration: none; }
    .footer-mark {
      width: 30px; height: 30px; flex-shrink: 0;
      background: url("/sibyl-labs-logo.png") center / contain no-repeat; /* dark mark on the creme footer */
    }
    html.dark .footer-mark { background-image: url("/sibyl-labs-logo-light.png"); } /* creme mark on the dark footer */
    .footer-wordmark {
      font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink);
    }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0;
    }
    .footer-socials { display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); margin-top: var(--space-2); }
    .footer-socials a {
      width: 40px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink-mute);
      transition: color .2s var(--ease), border-color .2s var(--ease), transform .2s var(--ease);
    }
    .footer-socials a:hover { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .footer-socials svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* link columns */
    .footer-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(8rem, 1fr)); gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .footer-nav { justify-self: end; } }
    .footer-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .footer-col-head {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .footer-col a {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0; min-height: 40px;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; transition: color .2s var(--ease);
    }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

    /* bottom bar */
    .footer-bar {
      max-width: var(--grid-max); margin: clamp(2.5rem, 5vh, 3.5rem) auto 0; padding-top: var(--space-4);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .footer-legal, .footer-agent {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); color: var(--ink-faint); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .footer-agent a { color: var(--ink-mute); transition: color .2s var(--ease); }
    .footer-agent a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

    /* === PRICING (Sibyl Memory tiers) === */
    .pricing-grid {
      margin-top: var(--space-7);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-5);
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .pricing-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    .price-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .price-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }
    .price-card .tier {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.32em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent-text);
    }
    .price-card .amount {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.008em;
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--ink);
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      font-feature-settings: 'lnum' on, 'tnum' on;
    }
    .price-card .amount .per {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
    }
    .price-card .tier-line {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: none;
    }
    .price-feats {
      list-style: none;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      flex-grow: 1;
    }
    .price-feats li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      padding: var(--space-3) 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .price-feats li::before {
      content: '';
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 0.55rem;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--accent);
      transform: translateY(-0.3em);
    }
    .price-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink);
      transition: all 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .price-cta:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      color: var(--accent-text);
    }
    .price-card.is-featured {
      border-color: var(--accent-line);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(138,106,42,0.05) 0%, var(--card) 34%);
    }
    @media (min-width: 901px) {
      .price-card.is-featured { transform: translateY(-0.5rem); }
    }
    .price-card.is-featured .price-cta {
      background: var(--accent);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--card);
    }
    .price-card.is-featured .price-cta:hover {
      background: var(--accent-deep);
      border-color: var(--accent-deep);
      color: var(--card);
    }
    .price-card.is-soon {
      background: transparent;
      border-style: dashed;
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    .price-card.is-soon .amount,
    .price-card.is-soon .tier-line,
    .price-card.is-soon .price-feats { opacity: 0.7; }
    /* Non-interactive placeholder CTA: keeps the three cards' CTA baseline
       aligned; deliberately inert (dashed, muted, no pointer). */
    .price-cta--ghost {
      border-style: dashed;
      border-color: var(--rule-strong);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      background: transparent;
      cursor: default;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .pricing-note {
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    /* === TWO-PRODUCT PRESENTATION (products-e) === */
    /* Elevated hero (.product-hero, singular = THIS page's hero; the plural
       .products-hero catalog header was legacy and has been removed) */
    .product-hero {
      padding: clamp(8rem, 20vh, 12rem) 0 clamp(4rem, 9vh, 6.5rem);
      position: relative;
    }
    .product-hero-h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: var(--fs-display-1);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      line-height: 1.06;
      color: var(--ink);
      max-width: 18ch;
      margin: var(--space-5) 0;
    }
    .product-hero-sub {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.3rem);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 46ch;
    }
    .cta-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
    }
    @media (max-width: 520px) {
      .cta-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
    }
    .cta-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 48px;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-6);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink);
      transition: all 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .cta-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      color: var(--accent-text);
    }
    .cta-btn--solid {
      background: var(--accent);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--card);
    }
    .cta-btn--solid:hover {
      background: var(--accent-deep);
      border-color: var(--accent-deep);
      color: var(--card);
    }
    .cta-btn--jade {
      color: var(--jade);
      border-color: rgba(45,110,106,0.45);
    }
    .cta-btn--jade:hover {
      border-color: var(--jade);
      background: var(--jade-faint);
      color: var(--jade);
    }
    .cta-btn--jade-solid {
      background: var(--jade);
      border-color: var(--jade);
      color: var(--card);
    }
    .cta-btn--jade-solid:hover {
      background: var(--jade-deep);
      border-color: var(--jade-deep);
      color: var(--card);
    }
    .product-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .product-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.008em;
      line-height: 1.05;
      color: var(--ink);
      max-width: none;
      margin-bottom: 0;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }
    .product-name .prod-icon {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      object-fit: contain;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .product-tagline {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: var(--fs-display-3);
      color: var(--accent-text);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
    }
    .product-body {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: var(--fs-lead);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 58ch;
    }
    .product-note {
      margin-top: var(--space-4);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      max-width: 58ch;
    }
    .feature-row {
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-5);
      max-width: 52rem;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .feature-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    .feature-row .feat {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--accent-line);
      padding-top: var(--space-3);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .product-head .uc-status,
    .price-head .uc-status {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.32rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .status-dev {
      background: var(--jade-faint);
      color: var(--jade);
      border: 1px solid rgba(45,110,106,0.25);
    }
    .pricing-sub { margin-top: clamp(4rem, 9vh, 6rem); }
    /* Pricing headline is semantically h3 (subsection of the Memory h2) but
       keeps the h2 visual scale. */
    .pricing-headline {
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: var(--fs-display-2);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      line-height: 1.18;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
      max-width: 32ch;
    }
    #pricing { scroll-margin-top: 5rem; }
    .product-block--sovereign {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--jade-faint) 0%, transparent 55%);
    }
    .product-block--sovereign .eyebrow,
    .product-block--sovereign .eyebrow .label { color: var(--jade); }
    .product-block--sovereign .product-tagline { color: var(--jade); }
    .pull-line {
      margin: var(--space-6) 0;
      padding-left: var(--space-5);
      border-left: 2px solid var(--pulse);

  <!-- ========== MOBILE DRAWER TOGGLE ========== -->
  <script>
    (function() {
      var hamburger = document.getElementById('nav-hamburger');
      var drawer = document.getElementById('nav-drawer');
      var overlay = document.getElementById('nav-drawer-overlay');
      var closeBtn = document.getElementById('nav-drawer-close');
      if (!hamburger || !drawer) return;
      var scrollPos = 0;

      function openDrawer() {
        scrollPos = window.pageYOffset;
        drawer.classList.add('open');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        document.body.style.position = 'fixed';
        document.body.style.top = '-' + scrollPos + 'px';
        document.body.style.width = '100%';
      }
      function closeDrawer() {
        drawer.classList.remove('open');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        document.body.style.position = '';
        document.body.style.top = '';
        document.body.style.width = '';
        window.scrollTo(0, scrollPos);
      }

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
      if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
      if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);

      // Close on link click
      drawer.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target.closest('a')) closeDrawer();
      });

      // Close on Escape
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && drawer.classList.contains('open')) {
          closeDrawer();
          hamburger.focus();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>

  <!-- ========== THEME TOGGLE ========== -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      var root = document.documentElement;
      var toggles = [document.getElementById('theme-toggle'), document.getElementById('theme-toggle-drawer')].filter(Boolean);
      if (!toggles.length) return;
      var themeMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');

      function syncState() {
        var isDark = root.classList.contains('dark');
        toggles.forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isDark ? 'true' : 'false');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-label', isDark ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode');
        });
        if (themeMeta) themeMeta.setAttribute('content', isDark ? '#100d07' : '#f5f1e6');
      }

      function toggleTheme() {
        var isDark = root.classList.toggle('dark');
        try { localStorage.setItem('sibyl-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light'); } catch (e) {}
        syncState();
      }

      toggles.forEach(function (btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', toggleTheme); });
      // Reflect the theme the no-flash head script already applied
      syncState();
    })();
  </script>
